===================================================================
CANDIDATE RESUME
===================================================================
Name: Alex Kumar
Email: alex.kumar@cs.university.edu
Phone: +91 98765 43210
Degree: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (3rd Year, Semester 6)
GPA: 9.1 / 10.0

OBJECTIVE:
Enthusiastic CS undergraduate passionate about Agentic AI architectures, LLM orchestration, parallel inference pipelines, and autonomous workflows. Seeking a high-impact AI/ML Internship.

EDUCATION:
- B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering | Dept of CSE (AIML) | 2023 - 2027
  Relevant Coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Distributed Systems, Data Structures & Algorithms.

TECHNICAL SKILLS:
- Languages: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, SQL
- Frameworks & Libraries: PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, FastAPI, React, Node.js, NumPy, Pandas
- Agentic & AI Tooling: MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling, LangChain, DSPy, Vector Databases (Qdrant, Chroma)
- Tools & DevOps: Git, Docker, Linux/WSL, REST APIs, WebSockets

PROJECTS:
1. Parallel Agent Orchestrator (pReAct Core):
   - Implemented a parallel tool-drafting agent breaking serial ReAct latency bottlenecks.
   - Categorical context partitioning reduced prompt prefill tokens and tool hallucination.
   - Built concurrent execution engine using Python asyncio and ThreadPoolExecutor.

2. High-Throughput RAG & Hybrid Search Engine:
   - Designed a semantic retrieval pipeline with dense embeddings and BM25 hybrid ranking.
   - Integrated streaming generation with FastAPI and WebSocket for sub-100ms response start.

3. Autonomous Code Reviewer Agent:
   - Built an MCP-compliant agent that pulls git diffs, analyzes ASTs, runs unit tests, and drafts pull request comments.

PUBLICATIONS / HONORS:
- 1st Place - National AI Agent Hackathon 2025
- Contributor to open-source agentic evaluation benchmarks
